title: fix(moderations): add illicit categories and make Categories/CategoryScores iterators return real values

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
+API breakage: enumelement ModerationsResult.Moderation.Categories.CodingKeys.illicit has been added as a new enum case
+API breakage: enumelement ModerationsResult.Moderation.Categories.CodingKeys.illicitViolent has been added as a new enum case
+API breakage: enumelement ModerationsResult.Moderation.CategoryScores.CodingKeys.illicit has been added as a new enum case
+API breakage: enumelement ModerationsResult.Moderation.CategoryScores.CodingKeys.illicitViolent has been added as a new enum case
+API breakage: func ModerationsResult.Moderation.CategoryScores.makeIterator() has return type change from Swift.IndexingIterator<[(Swift.String, Swift.Bool)]> to Swift.IndexingIterator<[(Swift.String, Swift.Double)]>
+API breakage: typealias ModerationsResult.Moderation.CategoryScores.Element has underlying type change from Swift.IndexingIterator<[(Swift.String, Swift.Bool)]>.Element to Swift.IndexingIterator<[(Swift.String, Swift.Double)]>.Element
+API breakage: typealias ModerationsResult.Moderation.CategoryScores.Iterator has underlying type change from Swift.IndexingIterator<[(Swift.String, Swift.Bool)]> to Swift.IndexingIterator<[(Swift.String, Swift.Double)]>

@@ -6,7 +6,11 @@ Compatibility promise: the public API is additive-only. Anything `public` is dep
 
 ## [Unreleased]
 
+### Added
+- `illicit` and `illicit/violent` on `ModerationsResult.Moderation.Categories` and `CategoryScores` (optional: `nil` for older moderation models or `null`), with the matching `CodingKeys` cases. `category_applied_input_types` is not modeled yet ([#489](https://github.com/MacPaw/OpenAI/issues/489)).
+
 ### Fixed
+- Iterating `ModerationsResult.Moderation.Categories` or `CategoryScores` crashed at runtime (`CategoryScores` iterated as `(String, Bool)` over `Double` values, through `Mirror` and a forced cast). Both now yield their real values explicitly; `CategoryScores.makeIterator()` is now `IndexingIterator<[(String, Double)]>` (accepted API break, see the API breakage allowlist) ([#505](https://github.com/MacPaw/OpenAI/pull/505)).
 - `APIError` now decodes a numeric `code`, as sent by `llama.cpp` server, as its string form instead of failing to decode the error.
 
 ## [0.6.1] - 2026-11-15
